subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• The Amphibian Conservation Archive (ACA) initiative aims to encourage young field biologists by cataloging and sharing information about the work of underrecognized herpetologists.
• Huda Dlamini is a herpetologist included in the ACA's Legacy Researchers Directory.
• She was born in 1931 and died in 2019.
prompt: Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to set up a discussion of Dlamini's career for an audience already familiar with the ACA initiative?

choices.A: While Huda Dlamini is considered a distinguished herpetologist, there are many more such researchers included in the ACA's Legacy Researchers Directory.
choices.B: Born in 1931, Huda Dlamini passed away in 2019 according to the ACA initiative.
choices.C: Among the many notable figures included in the ACA initiative is herpetologist Huda Dlamini.
choices.D: The ACA initiative's Legacy Researchers Directory highlights underrecognized herpetologists of the past, such as Huda Dlamini (1931–2019), in order to encourage young field biologists to pursue careers in the discipline.

explanation: Choice C is the best answer. The sentence effectively introduces Huda Dlamini to set up a discussion of her career for an audience already familiar with the ACA initiative, identifying Dlamini as one of the notable figures included in the initiative without providing background information about what the ACA initiative is or does.
